title: Dissociation of Human Neuroblastoma Tumors for Single-Cell RNA-seq
author: Anand Patel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.98ah9se
materials: Prepare reagents (1 set for each sample):

steps.title: Prepare enzyme mixture
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL Earle's Balanced Salt Solution (vial #1) to papain (vial #2) and dissolve for 15 min at 37 °C; add 500 µL Earle's Balanced Salt Solution (vial #1) to DNase I (vial #3) and mix at room temperature; then add 250 µL of the DNase I solution to the papain solution at room temperature.

steps.title: Mince tumor tissue
steps.instruction: Weigh 100–500 mg tumor tissue per papain vial, place on a sterile 60 mm tissue‑culture plate, and mince with a disposable scalpel into ~1 mm fragments in <5 min at room temperature. Process tissue immediately after receipt (tissue may be on ice until the start, but do not return to ice once dissociation begins).

steps.title: Incubate tissue with enzymes
steps.instruction: Transfer minced tissue to a sterile 15 mL Falcon conical tube, add the papain‑DNase mixture, and incubate in a 37 °C water bath for 15 min.

steps.title: First trituration
steps.instruction: Pipette the suspension up and down 10–15 times using a sterile 10 mL serologic pipette at room temperature.

steps.title: Second incubation
steps.instruction: Return the tube to the 37 °C water bath and incubate for an additional 15 min.

steps.title: Second trituration
steps.instruction: Pipette the suspension up and down 10–15 times again with a sterile 10 mL serologic pipette; the suspension should appear cloudy with debris.

steps.title: Filter and rinse
steps.instruction: Filter the cell suspension through a 40 µm cell strainer into a 50 mL Falcon tube, then rinse the strainer with 5 mL Earle's Balanced Salt Solution (vial #1).

steps.title: Centrifuge first pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtrate at 500 × g for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare resuspension buffer and gradient
steps.instruction: While the tube spins, prepare two 15 mL Falcon tubes: (1) Resuspension buffer – 2.7 mL Earle's Balanced Salt Solution (vial #1) + 300 µL Albumin‑ovomucoid inhibitor solution (vial #4) + 150 µL DNase I solution (vial #3) to a final volume of 3 mL; (2) Density gradient – 5 mL Albumin‑ovomucoid inhibitor solution (vial #4).

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate the first ~9 mL of supernatant with suction, then remove the remaining 0.5–1 mL with a micropipette, taking care not to disturb the pellet. If the pellet is hard to see, keep the removed 9.5 mL in a tube labeled “supernatant 1” as backup.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 3 mL of the prepared resuspension buffer and gently mix with a 5 mL serologic pipette.

steps.title: Layer over density gradient
steps.instruction: Carefully layer the resuspended cells over the 5 mL density‑gradient solution in the second 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge gradient
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the gradient tube at 100 × g for 6 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Remove gradient supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate the first ~7 mL of supernatant, then remove the final 0.5–1 mL with a micropipette, avoiding disturbance of the pellet. If the pellet is difficult to see, keep the removed 7.5 mL in a tube labeled “supernatant 2” as backup.

steps.title: Assess cell viability
steps.instruction: Mix 10 µL of the cell suspension with 10 µL Trypan blue, load 10 µL onto a hemacytometer, and count viable cells. Proceed only if viability is >80 %.

steps.title: Dilute to target concentration
steps.instruction: If needed, dilute the cell suspension to approximately 1 000 cells/µL so that ~10 000 cells will be loaded per 10x Genomics channel.

steps.title: Keep on ice and proceed
steps.instruction: Keep the diluted cell suspension on ice and immediately continue with the 10x Genomics 3′ single‑cell RNA‑sequencing workflow.

steps.title: Final wash and filtration
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellet in 10 mL Earle's Balanced Salt Solution, filter through a 40 µm cell strainer into a sterile 50 mL Falcon tube, and keep at room temperature.
